correctness.rationale: The harmonic minimum principle reduces the sharp order to the infimum of Re xi. The boundary singularity at 1 is controlled analytically and stays above the candidate. The real boundary function is symmetric; endpoint arcs have explicit lower bounds, while interval arithmetic certifies one derivative sign change and positive second derivative in a 1e-7 root bracket. Subordination transfers the target infimum to every class member, and the canonical extremal approaches the minimizing boundary value, proving sharpness.
